cases.study_information: Predict day-7 brain BMP22:6, relative to the assay internal standard, for affinity_weak_1 and affinity_weak_2. The 10 nM TfR-binding parent is a visible PD anchor. Constructs have the same PGRN-fusion format and receive 5 mg/kg IV in Grn-knockout mice. This is affinity-engineering transfer at a fixed dose and endpoint. Weaker TfR affinity need not give a monotonic change in brain pharmacodynamics. BMP22:6 is not a percentage of healthy rescue.

dependence_note: Shared experimental family; count in original-family sensitivity aggregation, not as independent biological replication.
title: Predicting how TfR-affinity engineering changes brain pharmacodynamics
